_about: Source art for the realm-border looks (docs/reviews/adopt-kingdom-borders-2026-09-30.md). Generated with ImagineArt on Mike's own account at his request, 2026-09-30. tile_*.png are derived by `python tools/realm_borders_preview.py tiles`.

imagineart_ink.png.prompt: A single hand-drawn cartographic border line on plain off-white paper, in the style of a vintage hand-inked fantasy map: a dash-dot-dash boundary line (short dashes alternating with small round dots) drawn with a dip pen in dark sepia iron-gall ink, slightly uneven pen pressure and tiny ink blots, perfectly straight and horizontal, running edge to edge across the entire width of the image exactly through the vertical center. Flat top-down scan, even lighting, no perspective, no other marks, no text, no frame, plain empty paper above and below the line.

imagineart_gold.png.prompt: A single twisted gold cord, like the braided gilt rope trim on a royal heraldic banner, lying perfectly straight and horizontal, running edge to edge across the entire width of the image exactly through the vertical center. Polished antique gold with fine twisted strands, soft highlights and deep shadows between the twists, subtle patina. Pure solid black background, flat top-down orthographic view, even studio lighting, no perspective, no tassels, no knots, nothing else in the image, no text.

imagineart_wash.png.prompt: One long horizontal watercolor band painted along a straight line with a flat brush on white cold-press watercolor paper, like the hand-tinted outline coloring along a border on an antique 18th century map: the pigment pools darkest in a crisp slightly ragged edge along the top of the band, then fades softly downward into transparent wash and bare paper, with natural pigment granulation, blooms and tide lines. Neutral grey-brown pigment only. The band runs edge to edge across the entire width of the image, its dark top edge exactly on the horizontal center line. Flat top-down scan, even lighting, no text, nothing else.

atlas_parchment.reference: one image only: a guide of the whole 1600 x 1600 TAOM_Map terrain square, north up, made from TAOM_Map/AssetSources/Vista_16K/16K_Vista_02.png (the painted middle band), with the terrain heightmap, the water mask and the shore strokes in TAOM_Map/AssetSources/Support filling the strips the vista leaves empty. A second reference for the style let that picture's own geography leak in, so the style is in the prompt.
atlas_parchment.prompt: Turn this painted map into an antique hand-inked parchment map by tracing it exactly, as if on a light table: keep every coastline, island, bay, lake, river, mountain range and forest in exactly the same position, shape and size as in this image, and change only the rendering style. Do not crop, zoom, shift, mirror or rotate, and do not add or remove any land, sea, island, bay or lake. Blue areas are sea and lakes: draw the sea as plain parchment with short horizontal wave hatching along the coasts, and outline the lakes with light hatching inside. Rendering: warm aged cream parchment with faint stains; dark sepia iron-gall ink; coastlines as confident slightly wobbly ink lines; the white and grey ridges as rows of small inked mountain peaks with hatched shading on one side; the darkest green patches as dense clusters of tiny inked trees; the green grassland as plain parchment with a few small hill arcs; the thin blue lines as thin ink rivers; the ice in the north and the tan deserts in the south as sparse dots and stippling; the black region as a ring of dark crosshatched volcanic peaks. Only sepia ink on parchment, no colour. Flat top-down view, north at the top, the map fills the whole image edge to edge. No text, no letters, no labels, no names, no compass rose, no frame, no border, no corner ornaments, no legend.
